changelog: Watched-dependent playback correction: Next Unwatched now selects the earliest chronologically unwatched episode for the active Jellyfin user; Random Unwatched selects only from that user's unwatched pool. Both modes hand off exactly one resolved Episode to normal Jellyfin VOD playback at 00:00, so episode title, elapsed/remaining duration, seek and subtitle behavior match the proven Sequential player. Episode completion always re-queries the active schedule block before resolving the next episode. Sequential playback is unchanged.
